name: My Tho
note: Research assigned 21 Oct 2026. Mekong Delta river town. Slug stays my-tho if a 2025 province border moved the city. Can Tho and Chau Doc stay neighbors, not this page. Ben Tre is the usual river day and stays a side-trip placeholder. No public place file until publish is accepted.

destination.note: Place shell on the Mekong corridor: interests, stay on 30 Thang 4, one day itinerary, and the Ho Chi Minh City road. Nearby is empty. No festival file. Vinh Trang and Thu Khoa Huan exist so the stops resolve. Sights without a licensed photo stay off the grid.

destinationCopy.note: Hero is the Tien embankment. Season prints 1623 and 1679 beside the 2024 festival dates. Unsourced fares and hours stay Check on arrival. Editor instructions were taken out of the public sentences.

destinationQuality.note: Read against the dossier. Both road pairs, both cart fares, both night clocks, and both settlement years are on the page. The card grid is Vinh Trang and Thu Khoa Huan. Other sights have no licensed photo and are not padded in.

food.note: Food guide and hu tieu My Tho only. Elephant-ear fish, ginger honey tea, coconut candy, night-court sweets, and banh tet have no licensed plate photo, so they are named and not cards.

foodCopy.note: Hu tieu prose names both origin lines and both broth lists. The plate photo is the soup bowl. Unpictured plates stay named, not cards. Stall price is Check on arrival.

foodQuality.note: Read the guide and the hu tieu page. History, culture, texture, taste, and how to eat are sourced. Both broth lists stay. No plate was invented for the unpictured dishes.

researchBase.note: Left out: boat fares, the Ấp Bắc bay number, taxi fares, and a passenger train. The HCMC–Can Tho railway is not open and does not name a Mỹ Tho station.

researchAttractions.note: Left out: a second tariff for the pagodas, the museum, and the cart; the Bửu Lâm year and midday close; the Bạch Công Tử interior; Đình Điều Hòa; and Thới Sơn boat fares.

researchFood.note: Left out: stall prices, a 2026 confirmation of the 2019 night-court hours, the day-market street, and a second eating street beyond 30/4.

researchNightlife.note: Left out: a 2026 confirmation that 288 Club still closes at 02:00, and any bar street beyond the embankment.

researchLifestyle.note: Left out: the hour the embankment goes quiet, and a named breakfast stall.

researchContext.note: Left out: a later date for the noodle festival, drive minutes to Ben Tre, Cai Be, Rach Gam, and Tan Thanh, and public pages for those neighbors.
